name: Venture validation (Soul Startup Studio)
mission: Kill or fund a startup idea on evidence, fast, with capped downside.

stages.name: 0 · Intake
stages.purpose: Turn a loose idea into a structured candidate.

criteria.label: Target customer and problem stated in one sentence
Why this studio / founder should build it

stages.name: 1 · Problem discovery
stages.purpose: Prove the problem is real, frequent, and painful.

criteria.label: Majority describe the problem unprompted and pay (time/money) for a workaround today

stages.name: 2 · Offer test
stages.purpose: Test whether a concrete offer earns behavioral commitment.

criteria.label: Offer is live (landing page, deck, or concierge)
One acquisition channel shows a repeatable signal

stages.name: 3 · Willingness to pay
stages.purpose: Money changes hands before the product exists.

criteria.label: No unresolved fatal legal, regulatory, or supply blocker

stages.name: 4 · MVP / pilot
stages.purpose: Deliver the promise manually or minimally and measure retention.

criteria.label: Retention / repeat usage above the pre-set bar

stages.name: 5 · Traction
stages.purpose: Repeatable acquisition with positive contribution margin.

criteria.label: Monthly revenue above the pre-set bar for 3 consecutive months
A venture lead (not the founder) owns weekly execution

stages.name: 6 · Fund / spin out / kill
stages.purpose: Make the capital and ownership decision.

criteria.label: Founder decision logged: fund, spin out, or kill

kill_rules: No behavioral evidence after two full experiment cycles → park.
Founder is the only person who can deliver it → redesign or kill.
Gross margin cannot plausibly exceed 50% → kill unless strategic.
